# GP18-master-eq:1 actual producer candidate corpus

`producer.json` contains actual unavailable, baseline, pending, transition, final,
settled, refusal, source-failure and disarmed recovery observations. Envelope requests
and replies accompany mutations; baseline/current/target owner JSON comes directly
from the actual owner. Fractional settings and normalized coefficients remain opaque
JSON strings. Companion owner fixtures live in SHR PA eq-v1 at the pinned commit.
SHA256SUMS and provenance.json pin exact bytes, producing source and old/new libraries.

Coordinator freeze is pending complete GigPies normal/Clippy/release gates. These are
software evidence; no physical audio or deadline/listening acceptance is inferred.
The selected transport campaign exercises actual Unix sockets and policy-authenticated
receive codec/endpoint dispatch, not a new TLS/QUIC handshake. Original transport
regressions remain normal and historical corpora retain their original bytes.
